usage.guide: Call GET https://api.trustsource.cc/robots?domain=<domain> with the domain you want to analyze as a query param (no request body). Payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.002 per call, no API key. The JSON response classifies the domain's robots.txt crawl policy: read body.tier for the overall classification, body.aiFriendly for whether AI training bots are broadly allowed, and body.ai.policies[] for per-bot (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.) allow/disallow rules. body.sitemaps[] lists sitemap URLs. NOTE: this endpoint could not actually be paid in the current QA sandbox due to a DNS limitation; it was only verified to return a healthy 402 challenge.
